products.description:
The Pinnacle MIGARC 145 is a compact, gasless MIG welding machine designed for DIY users, hobbyists, and light-duty workshop tasks. Operating on 220V single-phase power, it supports MIG (flux core), MMA (Stick), and Lift TIG welding—without the need for gas cylinders or regulators. With IGBT inverter technology, intuitive controls, and a lightweight design, it’s perfect for quick repairs, maintenance, and small fabrication jobs. Whether you're welding mild steel or tackling on-site fixes, the MIGARC 145 delivers clean welds and portable convenience

Features:

• Gasless Operation: No need for gas cylinders—runs on flux core wire for outdoor and mobile use
• Multi Process Capability: Supports MIG (flux core), MMA (Stick), and Lift TIG welding
• Compact & Lightweight: Weighs just 3.5kg with a small footprint—easy to store and transport
• Removable MB15 Torch: Convenient for maintenance and replacement
• IGBT Inverter Technology: Delivers stable arc performance and energy efficiency
• Beginner-Friendly Controls: Simple interface for quick setup and operation
• 1kg Spool Compatibility only: Designed for small-scale jobs and DIY applications
• Durable Build: Rugged casing with carry handle for workshop or field use

Specifications:

• Input Voltage: 220V ±15%, Single Phase
• Welding Processes: Gasless MIG (Flux Core), MMA (Stick), Lift TIG
• Output Range: MIG: 20–120A MMA: 20–120A Lift TIG: 20-100A
• Wire Diameter Compatibility: 0.8mm / 0.9mm / 1.0mm
• Drive Wheel: 0.8/1.0mm Knurled
• Electrode Size: 1.6mm – 3.2mm
• Spool Capacity: 1kg only
• Torch Type: Removable MB15 MIG Torch
• Dimensions: 30 × 17 × 25 cm
• Weight: 3.5kg
• Protection Class: IP21S
• Safety Compliance: IEC60974-1 certified

products.description:
The Pinnacle MIGARC 165 MIG-ARC Welding Inverter is a compact, high-performance multi process welder built for DIY enthusiasts and light industrial use. Operating on 220V single-phase input, it supports MIG (gas/gasless), MMA (Stick), and Lift TIG welding. With upgraded casing, reinforced corners, and a user-friendly digital interface, this machine delivers clean welds, stable arc control, and plug & play simplicity. Ideal for garage setups, mobile repairs, and workshop use, the MIGARC 165 includes a built-in wire feeder, removable MB15 torch, and heavy-duty earth clamp—making it one of the most versatile welders in its class.

Features

• Multi Process Capability: Welds MIG (gas & gasless), MMA (Stick), and Lift TIG
• Digital Inverter Technology: Microprocessor-controlled panel for precise settings and arc stability
• Plug & Play Interface: Simple front panel with mode selector and wire speed/amperage dials
• Compact & Portable: Lightweight design with reinforced casing for workshop or field use
• Built-In Wire Feeder: Internal spool holder supports 1kg flux core or solid wire
• Removable MB15 Torch: 2m torch with Euro connector for easy maintenance
• Heavy-Duty Earth Clamp: Upgraded 200A clamp for secure grounding
• Fan-Cooled System: Maintains performance under extended use
• Modern Aesthetic: Sleek, high-tech design that looks sharp in any garage or workspace
• Safety & Compliance: IP21S protection class, IEC60974-1 certified, 12-month warranty

Specifications

• Input Voltage: 220V ±10%, Single Phase
• Frequency: 50/60 Hz
• Welding Range: MIG: 30–160A MMA: 20–140A
• Duty Cycle: 60% @ 160A
• No-Load Voltage: 56V
• Wire Diameter Compatibility: 0.6mm / 0.8mm / 0.9mm / 1.0mm
• Electrode Size: 2.0mm – 3.2mm
• Spool Capacity: 1kg only
• Dimensions: 450 × 350 × 230mm
• Weight: 7.5kg
• Warranty: 12 Months

• Pinnacle MIGARC 165 MIG-ARC Welding Inverter – 220V
